messages:
michelle: Heads-up — we need to land the analytics entity flattening + read-guard for per-route sharding next week. PRs incoming, need a short playbook.
aj: +1. My sketch: dualwrite v1 -> v2, a lightweight read adapter that honors a `read_guard` flag, and a small console shim to switch dashboards to v2 when the flag flips.
sanjay: Curious about query compatibility. If we flatten 'route_metadata' into top-level attrs, some legacy reads will break (joins -> simple selects). We should add a compatibility view for psql reads.
kevin: Agree on view. Also: index strategy matters for sharded tenants. We should avoid a full backfill in one shot. Propose per-shard backfills with throttled jobs and a circuit breaker.
michelle: Can we keep the console UX simple? Engineers shouldn't have to toggle many flags. Maybe one rollout toggle per workspace + auto-fallback on errors.
aj: That works. Implementation details: 1) Dual-write via ingest-middleware (dualtable) 2) Shadow read path with `read_guard` header 3) Console rollout route that flips header for a given workspace id 4) Telemetry events for failures so we can auto-roll back.
sanjay: Example read guard check we talked about:
```sql
-- prefer v2 flattened if guard on
SELECT * FROM analytics_v2.route_metrics WHERE workspace_id = $1
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM analytics_v1.route_metrics WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analytics_v2.route_metrics WHERE workspace_id = $1)
```
kevin: For backfill jobs, per-shard job pattern: `backfill.shard_id from..to --rate=2000` and track progress via `backfill_progress` table. Also mark shards DONE to skip reprocessing.
michelle: Deployment order checklist?
aj: Minimal checklist:
- deploy dualwrite code (ingest) in canary
- start dualwrite shadow for a small tenant set
- wire read_guard header in API gateway (feature flag)
- expose console rollout toggle (dark launch)
- run per-shard backfills (monitor p99 + error rate)
- flip read_guard for 5% of workspaces -> 25 -> 100 with canary metrics
- verify dashboard parity & roll out globally
sanjay: Metrics to watch: dashboard query error rate, row counts delta (v1 vs v2), ingest lag, console render time, and any unexpected cardinality spikes. Emit a `schema_migration.audit` event for any discrepancy.
kevin: Edge case: some tenants have custom SQL in their saved reports referencing JSON path. We'll add a lightweight compat-layer that maps old JSON paths to new columns, but we must record those tenants and notify them.
michelle: Who owns tenant notification + docs? @kevin?
kevin: I can draft the docs + notification template. Will need PM sign-off.
deploy-bot: deploy: ingest-dualwrite v2 -> succeeded on canary cluster (build 2026-03-19T18:12Z) :thumbsup:
aj: One more thought — add a read-time validation hook that, when `read_guard` is enabled, compares the v1/v2 query results for a sample subset and emits diffs into `telemetry.migration_diffs`. That gives us confidence during ramp.
sanjay: Love that. Also add a throttling policy for backfills if p99 CPU > 70% on DB cluster.
michelle: Great. Let's document the playbook and pick 3 tenants for the first canary tomorrow. I'll open a short PR with the checklist and link here. Thanks all. :rocket:
